readings.E1: calendar: W1 = D26's dates 2014-09-01 -> 2019-01-02 (1,070 sessions); W2 = each book's D17 dates of the EXTENDED published NAV from its first date (SCMO_0007: 2019-01-04) to END = the last row of the three D03 Master files (2026-10-30); rows after END are never used. As T11 E1 / T08 E1
readings.E2: decision dates = T0 and the last session of every later ISO week; the decision at the last session is made and not traded (T08 E2, T11 E2)
readings.E3: label = latest Master row dated <= decision date, per index and for MAUc1 (W1: D24b, W2: D24); regime IN / OUT-BUY / OUT-SELL from the three SIGNs and g; the Smallcap 100 rows are sliced to >= 2011-11-25
readings.E4: targets (e, gw) per rule from T14.md 2.1; gw while IN is carried in the log and never traded on (the trigger needs e < 1); one function `rule_arrays` serves the real series and every draw
readings.E5: initial position at T0's close, no cost, in every realisation: the target of the decision at T0 (IN: the basket in force, drifted from its availableDate, scaled to NAV 1; OUT: gw GOLDBEES, rest cash; e = 0.5: half the drifted basket and half GOLDBEES), T08/T11's convention
readings.E6: stock fill = OHLC4 of the Eikon bar (close if open/high/low is blank; the last close if no bar); GOLDBEES fill = T03's de-spike with the MCX range of the window's file (W1: D24b daily, W2: D12), raw OHLC4 where the range is missing (W2: every session after D12's last date), as T11 E8 / T08 E16
readings.E7: costs: T08's `trade` unchanged (cost = ow x value traded at the pre-cost targets, then every target scaled by (V-cost)/V)
readings.E8: a basket takes effect on the first session on or after its availableDate; skipped baskets dropped; weights renormalised. While e = 1 a basket change is T08's full reset trade (kind basket_change); while 0 < e < 1 (the -half regime) it is the D1 partial trade (kind basket_change, GOLDBEES and cash units unchanged, cost on the stock lines taken from the stock part); while e = 0 nothing is traded
readings.E9: trade kinds: switch_in / switch_out (e crosses 0 or 1 between IN and OUT-BUY; for -orig rules also IN <-> OUT-SELL), sleeve_rebalance (e = 0 on both sides, gw changed), and for the -half / -liq rules regime_in (into OUT-SELL) and regime_out (out of OUT-SELL); basket_change
readings.E10: cash level: the extended LBES (D11) as-of on sessions; R2 'liq': W1 liquidEtfFinal (LIQUIDCASE) over the whole window, W2 LBES to the session before 2024-01-24 then LIQUIDCASE returns (T08 E14); no accrual
readings.E11: constant mix at each rule's own averages: f = mean of e over the decisions, gw_bar = sum((1-e)gw)/sum(1-e); rebalanced at every decision date's next session and at every basket change while f > 0 (T11 E10 generalised); initial stock holding = drifted basket scaled by f
readings.E12: R3: W1 starts at the first D26 session on or after 2015-01-02 with its own spells, totals and bounds (T11 E11); W2 'live' starts at the first D17 session on or after 2021-11-01 with its own spells and totals but the book's FULL-window bounds (T08 E13); same seeds, free initial position in the state decided then
readings.E13: R7 (W1 only): T11 E12 unchanged: |close return| >= 20% stock-days on held stocks and the manual-export stock-days set to zero return by a return-preserving splice; the six rules at 0 and 20.8 bps
readings.E14: bounds of every series: lo = min(2, shortest spell of the state), hi = longest spell of the state, computed in the run; W2 asserted equal to T08's (in-or-out [2,46] in / [2,40] out, gold BUY [2,68] / SELL [2,28])
readings.E15: the four books have identical decision and gold series and share the draws; the draw states of each window are regenerated from the seeds and asserted equal to the stored draw_states.npz of T11 (W1) and T08 (W2) (V3, decision D2)
readings.E16: sessions_invested = daily returns earned while the parent is held; rules with e = 0.5 count as 'invested' only in the draws' IN weeks (the statistic is a property of the in-or-out series, as T11 E16)
readings.E17: trades_due of a draw = decisions j >= 1 with a session after them and e[j] != e[j-1] or (e[j] < 1 and gw[j] != gw[j-1]) (draws.csv `trades_due`; the recorded trades of the real rules are checked against it, V6)
readings.E18: V4(a): -orig rules reproduce the stored daily_nav.csv (relative 1e-12): W2 80-orig <- T08 strategy, 50-orig <- T08 strategy_fixed50 and T06 strategy (to 2026-10-22), hold_parent; W1 80-orig <- T11 strategy, 50-orig <- T11 strategy_fixed50, hold_parent; and the -orig rows of draws.csv equal the stored draws.csv (cagr, max_dd, end_nav; W2 R3 'live' <-> 'r3')
readings.E19: V4(f) seam / G0: the always-in 0-cost NAV on D17's dates against the published NAV, W2 from T0 (limits: +-0.25 pp/yr overall, +-0.5 pp each calendar year, T08 G0) and, for W1, over 2019-01-02 -> 2019-12-31 (+-0.5 pp, T11 V4(f)) from the W2 book's hold-parent path
readings.E20: draw_curves: the NAV of the first 20 draws and of 20 further draw ids (default_rng([17, 1]).choice(2000, 20), disclosed) of F1 and F3 at 20.8 bps for the six rules; the full NAV of every draw is not stored
readings.E21: regime ledger: OUT-SELL spell = maximal run of OUT-SELL decisions; returns from the close of the first spell decision's session to the close of the session of the decision that ends the spell (or the last session): parent = hold_parent 0-cost NAV, GOLDBEES = D09 close, cash = LBES level, each rule = its 20.8 bps NAV
